relations.subject: Khenpo Karthar Rinpoche
relations.evidence: at the age of 12 entered Thrangu Monastery to continue his education.

relations.subject: Khenpo Karthar Rinpoche
relations.evidence: he was sent by his guru the 8th Traleg Rinpoche to Thrangu Monastery for advanced education in Buddhist studies.

relations.subject: Khenpo Karthar Rinpoche
relations.evidence: After five years of study, at age 30, he was awarded the Khenpo degree and began teaching.

relations.subject: Khenpo Karthar Rinpoche
relations.evidence: In 1967 Rinpoche was called to Rumtek Monastery in Sikkim, India to teach the monks and engage in pastoral ministry

relations.subject: Khenpo Karthar Rinpoche
relations.evidence: Rinpoche traveled to New York City and then on to Woodstock, NY, where he founded Karma Triyana Dharmachakra (KTD) Monastery

relations.subject: Khenpo Karthar Rinpoche
relations.evidence: Before his death he served as abbot of Karma Triyana Dharmachakra (KTD) Monastery in Woodstock, New York.

relations.subject: Khenpo Karthar Rinpoche
relations.evidence: he transmitted the Khenpo Gangshar mind teachings ("Naturally Liberating Whatever You Meet," which he had received directly from Khenpo Gangshar)
